_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::tsi#9. One HEX8 SOLIDSCATRA cube, transient thermal field starting from 293 and driven to 393, two decks identical except for which section carries the 393. DESIGN VOL THERMO DIRICH CONDITIONS on the DVOL that lists all 8 nodes clamps every node: node 7 reads exactly 393, the cube expands uniformly by alpha*(393-293)*L = 1.2e-03, both result tests CORRECT, exit 0. DESIGN SURF THERMO DIRICH on the x=0 face alone prescribes the same 393 (SURF_PRESCRIBES_SAME_VALUE=1) and leaves the interior free: node 7 reads 2.93004731462221912e+02, still essentially its initial value, and the expansion collapses to 3.33374339339256561e-04. Nothing is warned about (SURF_DIAGNOSTIC=0) and the run reaches the result test, so the only detector is a pinned RESULT DESCRIPTION.
